whyChina.subtitle: Studying in China is not just quality education, but opening the door to wide opportunities for your future

1.title: High-quality education
1.description: Chinese universities are ranked in the TOP-100 worldwide and have the most modern scientific and technical base

2.title: Innovation center
2.description: The world's most advanced country in artificial intelligence, IT, robotics, and business

3.title: Affordable study costs
3.description: 2-3 times cheaper than Europe and the USA. Starting from $2000-4000 per year + scholarships

4.title: Cultural diversity
4.description: 5000 years of history, modern technology, and rich culture - this is not only education but also a school of life

5.title: Wide opportunities
5.description: Chinese language, international experience, and high salary in the future - jobs starting from $2000-5000

6.title: Modern infrastructure
6.description: Campus, laboratories, and sports complexes equipped with the latest technologies
